projects.title: Predicting Employee Attrition
projects.description: The goal of this project was to develop a machine learning model to predict whether an employee is likely to leave the company. The dataset includes features such as employee satisfaction level, average monthly hours, number of projects, tenure, and an indicator of whether the employee has left.
projects.description2: Two models were built — Random Forest and XGBoost — achieving AUC scores of 95.0% and 95.1% respectively. Satisfaction level, tenure, number of projects, and last evaluation score were the strongest predictors of turnover.

projects.title: CRM Sales Pipeline
projects.description: This project analyzes a CRM sales pipeline dataset. It revealed clear patterns in agent performance, product success, industry trends, and sales cycle dynamics.

projects.title: Data Science Salaries
projects.description: This project analyzes a global dataset of data science-related job salaries across job roles, compensation, experience levels, employment types, work models, and company details across multiple countries and years.

projects.title: Bike Sales
projects.description: This project demonstrated the process of cleaning and preparing raw sales data, producing a dashboard covering total revenue, order volume, peak sales day, top-selling product, and customer segmentation.
